pli-tv-bu-vb-pc58:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc58:1.2: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū ca paribbājakā ca Sāketā Sāvatthiṃ addhānamaggapaṭipannā honti. antarā magge corā nikkhamitvā te acchindiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc58:1.3: Sāvatthiyā rājabhaṭā nikkhamitvā te core sabhaṇḍe gahetvā bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pāhesuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc58:1.4: āgacchantu bhaddantā sakaṃ sakaṃ cīvaraṃ saṃjānitvā gaṇhantū 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc58:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma bhaddantā attano attano cīvaraṃ na saṃjānissantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc58:1.8: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc58:1.9: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc58:1.10: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā bhikkhūnaṃ tadanucchavikaṃ tadanulomikaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc58:1.11: tena hi bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpessāmi dasa atthavase paṭicca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc58:1.14: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc58:1.15.1: navaṃ pana bhikkhunā cīvaralābhena tiṇṇaṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇānaṃ aññataraṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇaṃ ādātabbaṃ nīlaṃ vā kaddamaṃ vā kāḷasāmaṃ vā. anādā ce bhikkhu tiṇṇaṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇānaṃ aññataraṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇaṃ navaṃ cīvaraṃ paribhuñjeyya, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc58:2.1.5: tiṇṇaṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇānaṃ aññataraṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇaṃ ādātabban ti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc58:2.1.13: anādā ce bhikkhu tiṇṇaṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇānaṃ aññataraṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇan ti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc58:2.1.14: antamaso kusaggena pi anādiyitvā tiṇṇaṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇānaṃ aññataraṃ dubbaṇṇakaraṇaṃ navaṃ cīvaraṃ paribhuñjati, āpatti pācittiyassa. ||1||
